description: Flat metadata schema for individual records from patient-derived iPSC differentiation experiments into neurons for neurodegenerative disease modeling, including genetic, protocol, batch, and phenotype descriptors.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual metadata record/sample/observation.

donor_id.descr: Unique identifier for the patient/donor source of the iPSC line.

donor_age_years.descr: Age of the donor at sample collection, in years.

donor_sex.descr: Biological sex of the donor; expected values such as male, female, intersex, unknown.

donor_ethnicity.descr: Self-reported or recorded ancestry/ethnicity, if available.

disease_name.descr: Primary neurodegenerative disease associated with the donor line; e.g., Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease.

disease_status.descr: Disease status of the donor; e.g., affected, carrier, unaffected control.

clinical_diagnosis_criteria.descr: Clinical or diagnostic basis used to assign the disease label, if applicable.

genetic_variant_id.descr: Variant identifier such as HGVS notation, dbSNP rsID, or internal variant code.

gene_symbol.descr: Official gene symbol for the affected gene, if applicable.

variant_class.descr: Variant class; e.g., missense, nonsense, frameshift, splice_site, CNV, repeat_expansion.

variant_zygosity.descr: Zygosity of the variant; e.g., heterozygous, homozygous, hemizygous.

variant_pathogenicity.descr: Pathogenicity interpretation; e.g., pathogenic, likely_pathogenic, VUS, likely_benign, benign.

ipsc_line_id.descr: Identifier for the iPSC line used to generate the neurons.

reprogramming_method.descr: Method used to generate iPSCs; e.g., Sendai virus, episomal, lentiviral.

cell_line_passage_number.descr: Passage number of the iPSC line at the time of differentiation or assay.

karyotype_status.descr: Karyotype quality or abnormality status; e.g., normal, abnormal, untested.

mycoplasma_status.descr: Mycoplasma test result for the culture; e.g., negative, positive, not_tested.

differentiation_batch_id.descr: Identifier for the differentiation batch/production run.

batch_replicate_number.descr: Replicate number within the differentiation batch.

protocol_id.descr: Identifier for the differentiation protocol or SOP version used.

protocol_name.descr: Human-readable name of the differentiation protocol.

neuronal_subtype.descr: Target neuronal subtype produced; e.g., cortical neuron, dopaminergic neuron, motor neuron.

lineage_specification_factors.descr: Growth factors, small molecules, and key inductive reagents used for lineage specification.

differentiation_end_date.descr: Date differentiation completed or sample was harvested.

days_in_vitro.descr: Number of days in culture at the time of assay or harvest.

culture_medium.descr: Primary medium used during neuronal differentiation or maintenance.

substrate_coating.descr: Surface coating or extracellular matrix used for culture; e.g., Matrigel, laminin, poly-D-lysine.

oxygen_tension_percent.descr: Incubation oxygen level as a percentage, if controlled.

phenotype_assay_id.descr: Identifier for the specific phenotype assay or measurement record.

morphology_description.descr: Qualitative description of neuronal morphology, including neurite complexity, soma shape, and clustering.

neurite_length_um.descr: Measured neurite length in micrometers, if quantified.

soma_diameter_um.descr: Measured soma diameter in micrometers, if quantified.

synaptic_activity_present.descr: Whether synaptic activity was detected in the sample.

synaptic_activity_measurement.descr: Quantitative synaptic activity readout, with assay-specific units such as Hz, pA, or event count/min.

electrophysiology_assay_type.descr: Type of electrophysiology or functional assay used; e.g., patch clamp, MEA, calcium imaging.

neuronal_marker_expression.descr: Summary of neuronal marker expression; e.g., MAP2+, TUJ1+, TH+, SYN1+, assay-specific scoring.

glial_contamination_level.descr: Estimated proportion or level of non-neuronal/glial contamination, if assessed.

cell_viability_percent.descr: Percent viable cells at the time of assay.

treatment_applied.descr: Whether a therapeutic or perturbation treatment was applied to the culture.

treatment_name.descr: Name of the therapeutic compound or intervention, if applied.

treatment_concentration.descr: Treatment concentration with unit specified in accompanying lab convention; e.g., nM, µM, ng/mL.

treatment_start_date.descr: Date treatment was initiated, if applicable.

treatment_duration_hours.descr: Duration of treatment exposure in hours.

assay_date.descr: Date the phenotype or functional assay was performed.

experimental_notes.descr: Free-text notes on deviations, observations, or contextual details relevant to the record.
